actual: Runtime evidence shows a malformed code string like 603819.S2026-06-01T01:59:30.734977444Z near a full-universe SQL path. The data loaders currently normalize any value containing a dot by uppercasing it without strict ts_code validation, so date/timestamp contamination can be passed as a ts_code parameter. This can surface as DB errors during WSL live QE model inference and block Paper v2 simulation before MiniQMT order submission.
